usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing SDN VNet's properties such as its VLAN/VXLAN tag, zone assignment, alias, or port-isolation setting. Requires 'SDN.Allocate' on '/sdn/zones/<zone>/<vnet>'; changes are staged and must be applied via POST /cluster/sdn/reload (or the Proxmox UI 'Apply' button) before taking effect on the data plane. Use the 'digest' parameter when making changes programmatically to guard against concurrent edits clobbering each other.

examples.summary: Reassign a VNet to a new VXLAN tag and enable VLAN-awareness

tips: Changes are not live until the SDN configuration is explicitly applied (POST /cluster/sdn/reload); plan for a brief propagation window.
To clear an optional field (e.g., alias), include its name in the 'delete' param as a comma-separated config-id list rather than passing an empty string.
The 'isolate-ports' flag affects all VM interfaces attached to this VNet's bridge — use with care on shared-bridge zones.
The 'vnet' identifier is immutable after creation; to rename, delete and recreate with get_cluster_sdn_vnets + delete_cluster_sdn_vnets_vnet + post_cluster_sdn_vnets.
